label: practice

test_cases.label: remove_last() removes in reverse order and empties list
test_cases.code:
lst = LinkedList()
for x in [3, 1, 2, 6, 1]: lst.insert(x)
assert [lst.remove_last() for _ in range(5)] == [6, 3, 2, 1, 1]
assert lst.first is None

test_cases.label: remove() on empty list returns False
test_cases.code:
lst = LinkedList()
assert lst.remove(9) is False

test_cases.label: remove() handles head, interior, duplicates, and tail
test_cases.code:
lst = LinkedList()
for x in [1, 2, 2, 3, 5, 6, 6]: lst.insert(x)
assert lst.remove(0) is False
assert lst.remove(4) is False
assert lst.remove(9) is False
assert lst.remove(3) is True
assert lst.remove(3) is False
assert lst.remove(1) is True
assert lst.remove(2) is True
assert lst.remove(2) is True
assert lst.remove(2) is False
assert lst.remove(6) is True
assert lst.remove(6) is True
assert lst.remove(5) is True
assert lst.first is None
